statement: Blind annotation from the Beinecke scan alone (canvas '71v and 72r', the rightmost of four wheels; overview and four full-resolution quadrants). Centre: two clawed crustacean-like animals, the upper pale green and the lower red, with a short word in another script. Around them three rings of small nude figures standing full length without tubs, each reaching to a star with a wavy tail and each with a short label: I count 7 in the inner ring, 11 in the middle and 12 in the outer, matching the numbers of label lines in the three groups. One inner figure wears a spiked crown. No colour is used on the figures apart from red cheek dots and yellow star centres. Labels assigned from line ids and unit codes only, words not read: group f72r3.2-13 to the outer ring, 15-25 to the middle, 27-33 to the inner (by matching counts), each clockwise from the figure at the top; the starting point is my assumption, so label ids may be rotated by a constant within a ring. The right side of the wheel is stained along a fold and several figures there are hard to make out.

features.note: long-bodied animal with a segmented tail, several pairs of thin legs and two claws at the right end, washed pale green with red on the claws; lobster- or crayfish-like

features.note: same kind of animal painted solid red, pointing the opposite way; a thin line links the two animals; a short dark word in a different, Latin-like script is written under it
